abstract: Fetus in fetu is an uncommon anomaly in pediatric age group. There have been controversies regarding its differentiation from well differentiated teratoma. While presence of axial skeleton has been considered mandatory for diagnosis, there are many reports of fetus in fetu without any vertebral column. It has been suggested that the two entities form a spectrum of lesions depending upon the timing of embryological insult. The present case is another example of a lesion that fits in this spectrum of interesting lesion.
abstract_ja: 胎児内胎児は小児期に見られる稀な奇形です。高分化奇形腫との鑑別について論争があります。診断には体軸骨格の存在が必須とされてきましたが、脊柱を欠く胎児内胎児の報告も多数あります。両者は胚発生の障害時期に応じたスペクトラムを成すと考えられています。本症例はこのスペクトラムに当てはまる興味深い病変の一例です。
